checks.name: bounded-finding-coverage
checks.run:
from mission_control.funnel_founder_review import findings
rows=[dict(code='MISSING',next_action='Collect source')for i in range(101)]
result=findings(rows,100)
assert isinstance(result,dict) and result.get('shown')==100 and result.get('total')==101 and result.get('has_more') is True, 'Finding coverage must retain the actual total and bounded displayed rows'
